title: Z² Arrives: The Rookie Who Opened Her Career by Taking Down a Dynasty
body: Every club history starts somewhere, and Ghostu-Spider SZN's starts with a statement. In her first season of fantasy football, and the first season of the Buckaroo Football League's eight-team era, Zoe drew Kaushal in week 1, the man with two Buckaroo Bowl rings, and hung 129.6 points on him. That is still the best week of her career, and it announced that the lone Wisconsin native in a league full of Chicagoans had not come to be outnumbered quietly.

The 2026 campaign since then has been a proper rookie rollercoaster. Through seven weeks Ghostu-Spider SZN sits at 3-4 with 660.4 points for, roughly 94 a week, which is respectable company for a first-year manager. The low point came in week 5, a 69.1-point dud against Jordan. Losing to anyone with 69.1 stings, but losing to the person you share a living room with means the trash talk never actually leaves the building.

Her early head-to-head ledger reads like a rookie who plays up to the big names. She is 1-0 against Kaushal, 1-0 against Sonny, the reigning Buckaroo Bowl III champion, and 1-0 against Alan, so two title holders and the league's favorite antagonist have all taken an L from the newcomer. The other column is 0-1 against Ramon, Jordan, Mekhi and Randy, and that Randy loss surely got the full Bears-over-Packers victory lap.

As a manager, Zoe has been busy where it costs nothing and patient where it costs a lot. Seven waiver pickups say she is working the wire every week, though she dropped her head-to-head with Mekhi, who knows a thing or two about free agents. Zero trades say she is either building her roster her own way or has already learned that prying a player out of this league is like digging a car out of a Green Bay snowbank.

Where she stands now: the projections give Ghostu-Spider SZN a 0% shot at the title this season, so Buckaroo Bowl IV will probably have to wait. But a .429 rookie record with wins over both of the league's past champions is not a bad opening chapter. Zoe has spent seven weeks learning this league fast, and the managers she has not beaten yet should probably take notes for 2027.
